claim_en: JURISDICTION: lifnehem ('before THEM') defines the runtime environment — ordained judges in a chain to Moses; NEVER gentile courts (even where their law matches ours — outcome-identity does not license forum substitution; consent cannot cure); laymen barred from COERCION but curable by both parties' consent; today's courts run on the agency fiction (shelichutayhu) of the ordained.
source: TT 1:9 (Git 88b); Rashi 21:1; Ramban 21:1; Mizrachi 21:1:3; Ketzot CM 3:1; Ramban Deut 16:18; SA CM 22:2; Beit Yosef CM 26; Sheiltot 58; Tanchuma 6:1

claim_en: JUDGMENT/COERCION POWER SPLIT: tasim = the judges' INSTRUMENTS (strap, lash, shofar, sandal) — the coercion toolkit vests only in the ordained (lifnehem = the seventy elders); bare adjudication may sit lower. Modern gittin-coercion (coerced divorce documents) runs on agency.
source: TT 1:6 (San 7b); Lekach Tov 21:1; Ketzot HaChoshen CM 3:1; Pardes Yosef 21:1:3 (deterrence-by-display)

claim_en: PROMULGATION DUTY (rights-notice): tasim lifnehem = set like a laid table — teach REASONS, not rulings (Eruvin 54b: 'show them the faces'); and the law must reach ALL: a release-right unpublished is void — the sold man must know God freed him after six, else he cannot claim it; published defaults underwrite price-formation (no ignorance-based rescission).
source: TT 1:7; MdRS 21:1 (R. Akiva relay-spec); Or HaChaim 21:1:6; Tur HaArokh 21:1 (R. Yosef Kimchi); ShR 30:11 (promulgation precedes liability); Hirsch 21:1:2 (set-table philology); Netziv 21:1:2

claim_en: VAV-APPEND OPERATOR: ve-ele adds — 'as the former are from Sinai, so these': the civil code joined to the Decalogue in one revelation; Marah gave the generalities (klal), Sinai the details (prat) — two-phase legislation.
source: Mekhilta (TT 1:1); MdRS 21:1; Mizrachi 21:1:1; Maskil LeDavid 21:1:1; Kli Yakar Exod 15:23 (the Marah acrostic: sof-tevot of va-ele ha-mishpatim asher = מרה 'Marah')

claim_en: VENUE: the Sanhedrin sits BESIDE THE ALTAR (adjacency of Exod 20:23 to 21:1) — whatever disqualifies at the altar disqualifies the bench; capital jurisdiction is gated on the venue (suspended when the court exiled itself).
source: TT 1:5; Rashi 21:1; ShR 30; Kli Yakar 21:1 (the Solomon's-throne isomorphism); SMaG Pos 102 (venue-dependency); Yeriot Shlomo 21:1; Marot HaTzoveot I Kings 2:28 (Joab)

claim_en: GENDER PARITY: lifnehem — Scripture equated woman to man for ALL monetary law (BK 15a); where 'ish' is written it excludes the minor, not the woman.
source: TT 1:8 (Kid 35a); Bach CM 349; Pardes Yosef 21:1 (the tav-prefix dual-gender grammar); Yer.BK 1:3:2

claim_en: COMPROMISE-FIRST: the judge is commanded to offer settlement BEFORE judgment (only before the ruling is clear; requires both parties' consent; compromise-competence requires din-competence — the layman's compromise is robbery); judgment itself = mercy mixed with din.
source: Midrash Aggadah 21:1 (notarikon); Kitzur Ba'al HaTurim; Sheiltot 58 (mitzvah livtzoa); Tzror HaMor 21:1 (flee-from-din; hedyot-compromise rule)

claim_en: ENTRY PATHS (class split): ki tiqne = the COURT-SOLD THIEF only (male; insolvent; sold for the PRINCIPAL never the fine; witnesses required, no confession-sale) — the self-seller (Lev 25) is a distinct class: no piercing, no shifchah (fork: R. Eliezer grants via mishneh sekhar sakhir), term by contract (6+ allowed), no severance (fork), exits with children always.
source: TT 2:1; Mekhilta; Malbim 21:2:1; Yalkut 310; PY 21:11 appendix; Yer.Sotah 3:8:7 (bi-gnevato ve-lo bi-khfelo); Levush HaOrah 21:2:1 (one-subject-one-pericope)

claim_en: SALE PROPORTIONALITY GATE: sold only if the theft >= his worth ('sold WHOLE, never half' — nimkar kullo ve-lo chetzyo); theft 500/worth 1000 → NOT sold (labor impounded instead); the VICTIM holds an option: sell, or take a promissory note; never resold to the same man for one theft; two thefts → resale possible.
source: Yalkut 342:6 (Mechilta); Kid 18a (Hirsch 21:6:8); Mishneh LaMelech Slaves 2:3 (damav muvla'in); Abarbanel 21:1 essay

claim_en: THE TWO CLOCKS: u-va-sheviit WITHOUT 'shanah' = the seventh of the SALE (anniversary clock, me'et le'et, day-to-day) — NOT the calendar shemittah (which never frees him; yovel does). Exit at the START of year seven; leap-year edge: a term ending in Adar extends to Adar II's end; calendar-edge: term ending Rosh Chodesh Nisan bars work already on 29 Adar (retroactive month-sanctification risk).
source: TT 2:7 (Arakh 18b), 2:8 (Yer.Kid), 2:10; Malbim Ayelet 84; Rashbam 21:2:2; Lev 25:15:4 (Hirsch: the reckoning taxonomy); PY 21:2:3 (Minchat Chinukh edge; muchzak-in-his-own-body)

claim_en: TIMER SEMANTICS (fault-typed): the RUNAWAY completes his term (left the domain); the SICK exit ON TIME — sick ≤3 years counts, sick 4+ (majority) completes; light-duty capability (needle-work) keeps the clock running; composite sequences resolved by but-for counterfactuals; chinam = no repayment of idle-time, food, or medical outlays.
source: TT 2:5 (Kid 17a); Rav Sheshet (Kid 17a, ma'aseh machat); Yer.Kid 1:2:7; Malbim 21:2:7 (state/domain distinction); Midrash Tannaim Deut 15; RB 21:2:4 (the Isaiah 16:14 three-year constant)

claim_en: CHINAM (exit-free): the term expires AUTOMATICALLY — no manumission document, no payment (auto-expiry vs sanctity-acquisition semantics: his body is acquired, yet the acquisition is non-absolute); EARLY status-change (waiver of remaining money) still requires the instrument (Rava: his body is acquired).
source: Netziv 21:2:3; Lekach Tov 21:2; SMaG Pos 83 (Rava); Alshekh 21:1:9 (self-executing exit)

claim_en: SERVICE INHERITANCE: the term passes to the SON only (not daughter/brother/heir) — son-substitution outranks yibbum-substitution ('is there yibbum where there is a son?'); the pierced slave and the amah serve NO heir.
source: TT 2:6; Yalkut 311:3, 898:3 (Kid 17b); Rashbam BB 108b; Tractate Avadim; Hadar Zekenim 21:2:1 (ribbui+miut composition)

claim_en: DIGNITY FLOOR: 'eved' is a technical status tag, not a permitted insult ('the Torah called him slave against its will'); no slave-labor customs (foot-washing, sandal-carrying, litter, bathhouse gear); no trade-switch, no public-serving trade; equality in food, drink, bedding ('who buys a Hebrew slave buys himself a master' — the one-bed case: the slave gets it, kofin al middat Sedom); work only at his prior craft, by day.
source: TT 2:2; Yalkut 310-311; Sifra Behar 7:3 (the imakh parity spec); Hirsch 21:5 (Kid 22a); Lev 25:39:5 (Tosafot Kid 20a); Divrei David 21:2:4; Malbim 21:2:3 (asymmetric address)

claim_en: MODULE DEPENDENCY: the Hebrew slave law operates ONLY while yovel operates (dormant now); mass non-compliance disables yovel itself (majority-compliance as a runtime dependency); slave-release was the FIRST law given (precondition of redemption) and Jeremiah 34 makes its breach the fall of the state.
source: ShM Pos 233; Tur YD 267 (dormancy flag); R. Perla Pos 64:11; Gittin 65a (Chinukh 43:4); Arakhin 33a; Hirsch 21:6:11 (Yer. RH: the first law); MC Mishpatim 7 (yovel-lapse contingency)

claim_en: MAINTENANCE: the master feeds the slave's WIFE (from 'his wife goes out with him' — 'was SHE sold?!'; the exit reveals the entry-state) and his CHILDREN to age six (from Lev 25:41) — the master ENTERS THE HUSBAND'S PLACE (substitution model; expectation-preservation); excludes the betrothed (not 'with him'), the levirate-widow, and forbidden unions (the fit-to-remain predicate); their earnings are the SLAVE's, not the master's.
source: TT 3:4 (Kid 22a); Ramban 21:3; MdRS 21:3; Malbim 21:3:3; HKV Lev 25:41 (Behar as derivation parent); Chatam Sofer 4 (the computed delta: term=6 x maintenance-window=6); Rambam/Ramban earnings fork (Hirsch 21:3)

claim_en: CHILD-SUPPORT SIX-YEAR FLOOR: from the term-length the chain derives the father's duty to maintain his minor children to age SIX (the sale-term generates the obligation-length); beyond six — charity-coercion only, with public shaming ('a raven wants its young!').
source: Ralbag root 9 (Ketubot ch.5); SMaG Neg 81; Chatam Sofer 4; PY Lev 25:41

claim_en: SHIFCHAH PROVISION: master MAY (permission per R. Yishmael; Deut's doubling adds compulsion-power; the slave's own consent is a separate track) give a Canaanite bondwoman to the MARRIED slave only — the union exclusive (meyuchedet lo, not hefker), one wife to one slave; the wife-first condition is ANTI-RETENTION ENGINEERING (the single man would attach and refuse exit — golden-handcuffs ban; also a perverse-incentive block: a single man might self-sell FOR a shifchah) and PRICING (the married thief is unsaleable without the breeding-right compensating his family's upkeep).
source: TT 3:2; Chizkuni 21:3:2; Or HaChaim 21:4:1-3; Paaneach Raza 5; Toledot Yitzchak (market-clearing); Kli Yakar 21:4:1; Tur HaArokh 21:3; Yalkut 312-313; HKV 21:3:1 (the two permission-tracks); Maskil LeDavid (compulsion via mishneh sekhar sakhir — 'his night-work is the shifchah')

claim_en: MATRILINEAL DESCENT RULE: 'the woman and her children shall be her master's' — wherever kiddushin cannot hold, the child follows the MOTHER (the shifchah branch of the four-case descent algorithm; the nokhrit branch from Deut 7); cascades: no levirate bond via a slave-brother, sibling-predicates excluded, R. Tarfon's mamzer-purification algorithm (clearing the forbidden-union taint from a lineage); children include tumtum/androginos; the singular tihyeh marks the mother as principal.
source: TT 4:5-9 (Yev/Kid); M.Kid 3:12; Yalkut 100:2; Malbim 21:4:3; Hirsch 21:4:2 (Kid 66b); GA Vayikra 18:9

claim_en: DECLARATION PROTOCOL: 'amor yomar' = said TWICE, while still a slave, within the LAST-PERUTAH WINDOW (start and end of the final perutah's worth — before it begins or after it ends the saying is void even if doubled); the content is an existence-checked parameter list ('my master, my wife, my children').
source: TT 5:1, 5:4 (Kid 22a); Yalkut 315:3 (Rava's window); MdRS 21:5 (three-sayings recension fork); Ralbag (the first-plurality arithmetic)

claim_en: THE BILATERAL CHECKLIST: piercing requires — he has wife+children AND the master has wife+children; love on BOTH sides; NEITHER party sick (both sick = teyku); the master's property BLESSED through him; each condition a hasty-decision guard (Hirsch's decision-theory). Tannaitic fork: R. Yishmael (conditions gate) vs R. Akiva (pierced either way).
source: MdRS 21:5; Yalkut 316:1; Yer.Kid 1:2:32; Tractate Avadim 3:1; Hirsch 21:5:1; RB 21:5 (per-word anchors); MC Mishpatim 6 (consent-scope: the son never consented to)

claim_en: PIERCING PROCEDURE: presentation to THE JUDGES (his sellers — the same court; elohim = judges, the resolver ruling; the court REBUKES first), then at the master's house: door OR doorpost valid for the STANDING stage, piercing into the DOOR only (standing, mounted — the door counts as two witnesses, for no door lacks its post); RIGHT ear (azen-azen from the metzora — the parameter server), cartilage vs lobe forked on the kohen-question (R. Meir: no kohen pierced ever); the MASTER PERSONALLY — no agent, no son, no court officer (essential-actor: 'that HE pierce from beginning to end'); no batching (two slaves at once barred; body-title cannot vest by halves).
source: TT 6:1-7; LM Slaves 3:9 (two-stage decomposition); Yalkut 317; Rogatchover 21:6, 21:8; Yeriot Shlomo 21:6 (two-witness door); Mizrachi/Maskil venue forks; Chizkuni 21:6:2 (the bore-matching credential); Netziv 21:6:1 (rebuke-first)

claim_en: THE OVERRIDE REGISTRY (halakhah uproots the text): 'the Torah said WITH AN AWL — the halakhah said: with anything' — one of the canonical THREE (dust/get/awl; Yer. adds a fourth vs the derivation-output); the GRA's manifesto: the override is THE NORM ('so in most of this parashah — the Oral Torah turns the material like clay under the seal'); counter-programs preserved: Rabbi (metal only, kelal-uferat; rejects the override), HKV (the halakhah found INSIDE the lexicon — olam = ascent/yovel, no uprooting needed), Rashi (semantic rebinding: 'fifty years are CALLED olam').
source: Sifrei Dev 122:1; LT 21:6:5; Yalkut 898:7; GRA Aderet Eliyahu 21:6:2; Malbim 21:6:5 (tannaitic pedigree); Yer.Kid 1:2:29; HKV 21:6:2; Rashi 21:6:4; Rashbam manifesto 21:1:1

claim_en: LE-OLAM = TO THE YOVEL (the pierced one's bounded forever): the four-verse mutual lock (Kid 15a) assigns each yovel-release verse to its case; the pierced serves the master ALONE (causal-lapse: when the love's object dies the effect lapses) and exits at yovel or the master's death; the pshat layer ('all his days' — Rashbam) preserved as the second channel; Samuel's ad-olam = 50 as the bounded witness.
source: TT 6:12 (Kid 15a); GA Lev 25:10:3 (the 4-verse lock); Ralbag root 12; Rashbam 21:6:3 (fork); Malbim 21:6:6-7; Yalkut 899:2 (olamo shel yovel)

claim_en: RATIONALE LAYER (organ/instrument selection): the EAR that heard at Sinai ('do not steal' — the property-theft ban nested in the Decalogue's headline; or 'they are MY slaves — not slaves of slaves' for the self-seller); DOOR AND DOORPOST the Egypt witnesses (Passover blood); the awl's 400 = Egypt's decreed term; the piercing punishes the free CHOICE at six, not the coerced sale (no double jeopardy; retroactive disclosure); slaves are EXEMPT from the yoke of Heaven — human mastery and divine Kingship as exclusive occupancies (the Zohar's chinam).
source: TT 6:3, 6:9 (Kid 22b); Chizkuni 21:6 (la-tignovu precision); Mizrachi 21:6:4 (nesting); Kli Yakar 21:5:1-2; Rosh 21:6 (bitachon-reading; gematria 400); Siftei Kohen/Zohar (the yoke); Hirsch 21:6:10 (door=belonging, posts=home)

claim_en: AMAH ENTRY: only the FATHER sells (not mother, not self, never for her theft — women are never sold or pierced), only a MINOR (the sale-window closes at signs — the already-sold exits at signs, a-fortiori the unsold cannot enter; the male signs-exit is DEAD CODE: no reachable male-minor-slave state), only under TOTAL DESTITUTION (house, land, last shirt sold first — the sofei-tevot 'yerushato'), and only to a marriage-possible buyer: THE SALE IS MARRIAGE-TRACK BY DESIGN (yiud as the sale's default state — 'she is designated by default'; every sale of a daughter is a betrayal).
source: MdRS 21:7; Yalkut 319; Kid 20a/Rambam 4:2 (Hirsch 21:7:2); Chizkuni 21:7 (dead-code); Hadar Zekenim 21:7; Ramban 21:8 (default-yiud); Siftei Kohen acrostic; TT 7:4 (Arakh 29b)

claim_en: LO TETZE KE-TZET HA-AVADIM (multi-reading, all preserved): (a) halakhic — she does not exit by limb-loss like Canaanites (damages instead; the hekesh extends the male the same way); (b) dignity — indoor work only, never sent to the market ('the king's daughter's honor is within' — the Mahari Bruna precedent: a hired maid cannot be compelled to outdoor errands; TDbE's famine-exploitation rationale grounding the daughters-first estate takkanah); (c) Rambam shoresh 8: the clause is a NEGATION (information), not a prohibition — the statement-type doctrine.
source: TT 3:1, 7:8; Mahari Bruna 241 (PY 21:7:1); TDbE 23:1; Chizkuni 21:7; Shorashim 8:4; BeHaG/Ramban 21:7 (protective-lav fork); Netziv 21:7:1 (no slave-exit applies — purchase-intent)

claim_en: YIUD MECHANICS: designation = EIRUSIN by the ORIGINAL purchase-money ('the first monies were given for kiddushin' — retroactive conversion; fork: R. Yose b.R. Yehudah), no new act needed; requires HER consent (ein yiud ela mi-da'atah — the word yi'ed itself encodes mutual union; Rambam vs Tosafot fork) AND his — the qere lo ('to him') carries his refusal, the KETIV lo ('not') carries HER veto (consent-symmetry); the mitzvah of yiud PRECEDES redemption (the canonical priority ladder) and is UNWAIVABLE BY CONTRACT (sale 'on condition of no yiud': sale valid, condition VOID — matneh al ma she-katuv ba-Torah; R. Meir/R. Akiva forks preserved); no designating two at once.
source: TT 8:4-6; MdRS 21:8 (consent + generalized to all women); Or HaChaim 21:8:1; Tractate Avadim 1:5-6; Yer.Kid 1:2:25 (waivability typology); Hirsch 21:8:1 (yi'ed/yachad philology; qere-primacy); Soferim 6:5 + Minchat Shai (the ketiv/qere registry); Malbim 21:8:1 (the revealed-intent trigger)

claim_en: REDEMPTION (ve-hefdah): GRADUATED, FLAT-RATE, SUBSIDIZED — price prorated linearly by years served at the ORIGINAL per-year rate (deduction at cost, not market: she was bought weak and cheap, is now grown and worth more — the master genuinely subsidizes; anti-appraisal made explicit; fork: Maharal's concession-against-ownership vs the value-curve); the master MUST cooperate (causative ve-hefdah, 'he reckons with her'); the father is FORCED to redeem if able, the family liable after him ('we redeem her against the father's will, for the family's blemish'); the master must accept current-value assessment and she exits against his will; a sale is VALID ONLY IF ITS RELEASE-MECHANISM IS OPERABLE (no purchase without a working exit — sale to a relative where yiud is impossible is no sale; no amah for one perutah).
source: TT 8:5-6 (Kid 14b); Rosh 21:8:1; Chizkuni 21:8:4; Hadar Zekenim 21:8:2 (Orleans value-curve); GA 21:8:4; Riva 21:8:1 (the dumya-de-yiud principle); Hirsch 21:8:2; Chinukh 44 (worked vector); PY 21:11 appendix

claim_en: NO-RESALE (le-am nokhri lo yimshol): the no-transfer rule — master may never resell or gift; the father may not resell after yiud-track betrayal (bevigdo bah = the ONE-WAY DOOR / absorbing state; the fork three ways: garment-spread = marriage / betrayal = deceit / dominion — plus the vocalization channels ruled BOTH operative); addressee forks preserved (another man / actual gentile / the buyer's household / the convert community / warning TO THE COURT); 'psychological foreignness': after betrayal every new house is a foreign people; the attempted sale is VOID, not lashable.
source: TT 8:7-8; Onkelos/Chinukh 45; Ramban 21:8; Levush 21:8:1; Malbim 21:8:3-4 (the fork mapped to divorce-law systems); RB 21:8:2 (yesh em la-mikra/masoret); Hirsch 21:8:3 (am = circle; ein mokhrah li-krovim); LT 21:8 (azharah le-beit-din)

claim_en: SON-SUBSTITUTION: the master may designate her to his SON (in the father's lifetime; the son needs the ADULT son's assent per the psak) — the son inherits the paid consideration ('you are designated to me by the money my father received'); the BROTHER never (son stands in for TWO institutions — yiud and the ancestral field — the brother only for yibbum; the yibbum k'v blocked by 'his son'); the power DERIVED from the father's duty to marry off his son (hence no grandson-yiud, no yiud by a woman owner).
source: TT 9:1; Tractate Avadim 1:7; Yalkut 320:6; Rogatchover 21:10 (duty-derived power); Rashi 21:9 (the formula); MT Slaves 4 (adult-son assent); Bartenura 21:2 (standings-count)

claim_en: KE-MISHPAT HA-BANOT — THE INVERSION OPERATOR: 'it came to teach and ended up taught' (ba lelamed ve-nimtza lamed): the daughters'-law the verse cites is WRITTEN NOWHERE — the amah-clause is the SOURCE of every Jewish wife's rights (R. Yoshiyah; R. Yonatan reads the direction reversed — both preserved with Malbim's formal rule); stated at the SON because there disrespect is most likely (the extreme-example drafting canon); the Torah's only husband-duties law is legislated on the beggar's child — 'not by one hairbreadth may the treatment differ' (olah imo ve-einah yoredet, the station-ratchet).
source: TT 9:2; Mekhilta (Siftei Chakhamim 21:9:3); Yalkut 320:7; Malbim 21:9:2; Hirsch 21:9-10 (hairbreadth maxim); MdRS 21:9 (bidirectional); Chinukh 46

claim_en: THE TRIAD (she'erah kesutah ve-onatah): the three-field obligation record — the tannaitic PERMUTATION TABLE preserved (R. Yoshiyah: food/clothing/conjugal; Rebbi: conjugal/clothing/food; R. Yonatan: all three = clothing, age- and season-indexed; Rashbam's peshat: food/clothing/DWELLING; Saadia: 'her times'); toggles independently deoraita/derabbanan (the psak cascade rides Onkelos's ONE WORD she'erah=zionah 'her sustenance'); runtime-parameterized: clothing by age and season, food by locale-median, onah by OCCUPATION (the Ketubot 61b table: idle nightly … sailors six-monthly; scholars Shabbat-eve) and health; the station-ratchet (rises with him, never descends).
source: TT 10:4-5 (Ket 47b-48a); Yalkut 321:1 (the permutation table); Minei Targuma (the mega-fork + psak cascade); Netinah LaGer; Rashbam 21:10:3; Tafsir Rasag; Tur EH 70/76 (deployed constants); SMaG Neg 81 (locale re-binding); Rasag Pos 70-72 (three separate commandments)

claim_en: LO YIGRA (the no-diminish lav): protects the ALREADY-designated first holder against the new match; violation carries no lashes (actless negative); vows CANNOT defeat the duty (the pre-existing lien beats the vow — the anti-override registry); WAIVABILITY TYPOLOGY: money-duties (food/clothing) waivable by her, ONAH never (tzaara de-gufa — body-rights are not stipulable); who-waives distinguished from what-is-waived; the rebellion-fine system runs on this verse (mored: +36 barley-weights of silver weekly onto her ketubah; moredet −7 dinars); withholding-to-pain violates the lav; illness tolls six months max, then permission or divorce+ketubah; polygamy capped by the SCHEDULE ARITHMETIC (each wife's monthly onah) and by capacity (resource-constraint precondition).
source: TT 10:6-7 (Ned 15b); Yer.Kid 1:2:25; Gittin 84b; Tur EH 72/76-77; SA EH 76:11, 77:1; M.Ket 5:7; MT Marriage 12:2, 14:7-15; Sforno 21:10 (capacity); MC Mishpatim 8-10 (the compelled-divorce source: 'kofin oto lehotzi')

claim_en: SHELOSH ELEH: the three = yiud-to-him / yiud-to-son / redemption (NOT the triad — post-yiud she is a WIFE exiting only by get; the halakhot 'said at Sinai and attached to the verse'); Or HaChaim's pshat layer and Ibn Ezra's triad-reading preserved (MC's rehabilitation: breach of the triad = compelled release, 'a broad source for all compelled divorces'); the three form a state machine with ONE ABSORBING BRANCH (yiud kills the signs-exit; redemption leaves it live); mutually exclusive by construction (to him AND his son unsatisfiable → disjunction).
source: TT 11:1; MdRS 21:11 (both tannaitic ways); Yalkut 321:2; Taz 21:11:1 (absorbing-state); GA 21:11:1; Or HaChaim 21:9-11; MC Mishpatim 8-10; Rosh 21:11 (the get-proof); Maskil (the construct-sheva grammar)

claim_en: THE DOUBLED EXIT (chinam / ein kasef): two exit-times — naarut (signs) and bagrut — both written 'to give the litigant no opening to distinguish' (adversarial-robustness redundancy); the AILONIT edge (no naarut ever — the bagrut clause carries her case); ein kasef = 'no money for THIS master, but there IS for another master — THE FATHER': kiddushin-money and the father's-rights table derived from negation-scope; and the FOUNDING role: tractate Kiddushin's opening derivation — a wife is acquired by money FROM THIS CLAUSE; exit-instrument rule: free of money, NOT free of the get where designated; deduction-exit and flight carry NO severance-grant (the eligibility table; R. Meir's flip preserved).
source: TT 11:2-3 (Ket 46b, Kid 4a); Rashi 21:11:2; Riva 21:11:1; GA 21:11:2 (two-pass read); Yalkut 320:3, 936:5; Hirsch 21:11:1-3; Rogatchover 21:11 (four stacked readings); Yalkut 898:3 (severance table); LT 21:11:2

claim_en: EXIT PRIORITY: the amah's release = MIN() over exit-events — six years, yovel, signs, master's death (she serves no heir), redemption — 'whichever comes first precedes to free her' (kol ha-kodem kodem le-cheruta); the male's four (years/yovel/deduction/master's-death-without-son), the pierced one's two (yovel/master's death); the delta-table ('in her what is not in him'): signs-exit, forced redemption, never sold twice — vs his resale for a second theft.
source: Rashi 21:7:2 (the explicit min()); RB 21:3:2 (the numeric table); MdRS 21:2 (the five-exit summary as Mishnah-output); Yalkut 898:2; Tos.Sotah 2:8 (the gender asymmetry-table)

claim_en: THE BLOCK'S DESIGN THESIS: the rights-code OPENS with the criminal and the beggar's child — 'crime and poverty, the two factors that bring respect for a human being to zero, placed AT THE HEAD of the laws of human rights'; the ONLY deprivation of freedom in Torah law, and it is not punishment (repayment ≠ punishment; no prison in Torah jurisprudence); the six/seven term = the week's theology run as penology ('Six enslaves you, Seven makes you free'); the code compiled under a chapter-header that bars gentile-party case-law (the addressee-header constrains chapter content).
source: Hirsch 21:2:1-3, 21:6:5-9, 21:11:4; Ramban 21:2 (the 7-clock fractal); Abarbanel 21:2 (the non-derivable constant); Bachya/Siftei Kohen 21:2:1; MC Emor 123 (the header-constraint); Alshekh 21:1 (composition-consistency)
